limits: Checkpoints describe the gate work order and current source evidence. They are not new canonical Tasks, accepted gate steps or delivery dates.
Gate 1 is service execution authority. Gate 8 is generic human Wallet/secS/Devgraph workflow qualification. Shared runner infrastructure does not combine their acceptance.
Reviewed source and installed-wheel fixture evidence do not qualify the installed native issuer, result party or target custody.
Generic human Wallet fresh interactive approval is preserved; bounded unattended service issuance requires its own implemented native interface.
No identity, key, trust, grant, provider, deployment or production changes are performed by this plan.
Production entrypoints, real provider/effect recovery, full installed integration and cutover require their subsequent gates.
Source claims and canonical workflow progress remain separate; the gate is still open.

Service-owned source composition and opt-in packaging have accepted compatibility dispositions. Custody integration may proceed within the reviewed additive boundary. Altered generic contracts or shared custody behavior still require explicit compatibility disposition; live upgrades and affected Devgraph workflow dispatch remain separate from this source acceptance.

Checkpoint prerequisites govern checkpoint closure. Independent NS-05/06/07 source preparation may begin after NS-02, while their issuer integration checks await NS-04. NS-09 supplies final installed authority evidence; no earlier checkpoint waits on NS-09 or substitutes for canonical Task acceptance.

Initial release scope approved on 16 October 2026: install and run directly on the operator’s Mac and Example second Mac. macOS is the only supported target for this release. No virtual machine, restore-image download, Docker or Linux packaging is required to install or qualify this native Mac release. Admit each machine’s actual macOS version and CPU architecture from tested artifacts; neither machine’s compatibility is assumed. Existing broader OCI/Linux work remains unfinished and receives no completion credit. Physical-Mac harness acceptance and target enrolment remain pending; no gate pass, original Task acceptance, live installation or identity grant is created by this scope decision.

16 October scope clarification: VM tests are optional and removed from gate conditions. Component-owned direct macOS tests qualify the service pilot; the broader generic migration recorder is not a pilot dependency. No unimplemented authentication or gate acceptance is inferred.

The offline fallback is the supported CLI capture at 2026-10-16T21:00:45.157Z:100 records,67 core Tasks still not_started,33 Issue dependencies and93 read calls. Complete scoped workflow/version vectors match before and after Work/hierarchy and repeated dependency reads. The live observer can show newer captures and reports checked/capture times separately. Canonical progress changes only through supported authenticated Work operations; local implementation areas do not manufacture workflow completion.
